verdict.line: You win this if you force all-ins before level 6 and bleed Yorick's Mist Walkers before he clears them, but once his wall and Maiden come online you slide toward the measured 44.9% result over 49 games.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire kill pressure window is front-loaded: Q (Bear Trap) yanking into W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed and E (Jousting) dash-back is at its strongest before Yorick's wall and ultimate exist to counter it. Once Yorick hits 6 and starts carrying a Mist Walker clear plus Dark Procession to box you out, the lane-advantage numbers OP.GG cites for early pressure stop translating into the overall 44.9% head-to-head result.

theirWindow.what: He can drop the wall between you and him or box you against a lane edge. Don't commit to an extended trade near terrain while his W (cooldown 20/18/16/14/12s) is up, or you lose your own disengage.

yourWindow.what: Without Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow (cooldown 12/11/10/9/8s), Yorick has no tool to kite your E (Jousting) dash chain. Throw Q to hook and yank him, then E in and E again to dash back through for the second hit before he resets.

powerCurve.note: Maiden and wall swing lane control

start.why: Picked in 86.2% of games at a 48.2% win rate over 56 games; the lifesteal and AD let you win the early all-in trades that define this matchup before level 6.

boots.why: Run in 74.6% of games at 43.2% win rate over 44 games; the flat damage reduction blunts Yorick's auto-attacks and Mist Walker chip damage while you're forcing fights.

core.why: Most common first core item (part of the 17.7%-pick, 66.7%-win path over 6 games); the stacking HP and nuke proc give you the sustained damage to punch through Yorick's self-heal.
Second in the same build path; the armor shred stacks on top of your repeated E dashes and W attack-speed window to shorten extended trades.
Closes out the most-picked core path; the on-hit and structure damage help you convert lane pressure into objectives before Yorick's split push takes over.

situational.when: the game drags into extended skirmishes and you need the omnivamp to outlast Yorick's sustain
yorick's Q (Last Rites) healing is keeping him alive through your all-ins
yorick's Maiden-backed burst or a skirmish threatens to kill you before you land your combo

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive damage and healing fit Kled's extended all-in pattern (Q yank into E dash-chain), giving you the sustain to win drawn-out trades instead of just burst ones.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 80.3% of games at a 47.2% win rate; Ignite punishes your early all-in window by denying the healing from Yorick's Q (Last Rites) right when you're trying to convert lane pressure into a kill.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Your Q-W-E combo is strongest before Yorick's ultimate exists. Force fights from levels 1-5 while he has no Maiden to add extra damage or a body to soak your trades.

playing.title: Kill Mist Walkers first
playing.detail: Prioritize clearing Yorick's summoned Mist Walkers over trading face-to-face; denying his passive swarm stops him from clearing the wave for free and keeps lane pressure on him.

playing.title: Track your own mount bar
playing.detail: When Skaarl's health hits zero you dismount, lose Q (Bear Trap) for the weaker Pocket Pistol knockback, and deal less damage to champions. Disengage and rebuild courage rather than continuing the trade dismounted.

playing.title: Double-dash with E
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through your initial target for a second hit. Use the first cast to engage and the second to both deal more damage and reposition out of Yorick's range.

playing.title: Respect wall placement
playing.detail: Don't fight near terrain where Yorick's W (Dark Procession, cooldown 20/18/16/14/12s) can box you in or cut off your retreat. Bait it out in open lane first.

playing.title: Trade when his E is down
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor shred, slow, and mark are what let Yorick keep pace with you. All-in the moment it's down and you have a clean damage and mobility edge.

playing.title: Don't out-split him late
playing.detail: From level 9 onward Yorick's wall and Maiden make him a strong independent split pusher. Use your Hullbreaker/Titanic Hydra waveclear to match him, but look for teamfights rather than a 1-for-1 split race.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the timing, trade, and power-spike reasoning is the author's own tactical read of the kit, not OP.GG data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to gain control over lane during early game by applying pressure on Yorick. Do not let him clear lane easily by prioritizing on getting rid of his Mist Walkers and Maiden of the Mist first.
